Class PieceReaders

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.body.stream.PieceReaders
@Internal public final class PieceReaders extends Object
PieceReader support: the publisher of the elements a piece reader reads, the piece reader of a chunked reader that only reads a publisher, and the reader of one element per piece.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
